question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendments made Pondicherry (now Puducherry) a Union Territory?
solution:
The correct answer is __**14th Constitutional Amendment**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• With the ratification of the **Treaty of Cession by the Governments of India and France**, in **1962**, the French establishments of** Pondicherry, Karikal, Mahe and Yanam became territories of the Indian Union with effect from the year.**
 
• The 14th Amendment act provides for these territories being specified in the Constitution itself as a Union territory called Pondicherry.
 
 
• **Under Article 81(1)(b)** of the Constitution, not more than twenty members are to represent the Union territories in the House of the People.
 
• The Bill also provides for** representation of the territory in the Council of States.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• 28th Constitutional Amendment: **1972**
 
• 12th Constitutional Amendment: **1962**
 
• 32nd ​Constitutional Amendment: **1973**
